title: eSpring基金经理ChristinaWoon：人工智能热潮下需精选标
speaker: Christina Woon

segments.en: Our next guest, Christina Woon, is portfolio manager at eSpring investments. Christina, great to have you in the studio. So we're looking at, you know, quite a good start for this quarter so far.
segments.zh: 下一位嘉宾，Christina Woon，是eSpring的基金经理。Christina，欢迎来到演播室。我们看到本季度开局相当不错。

segments.en: All things considered Japan is outpacing career, but you also had that thematic of AI very clear in the second quarter.
segments.zh: 总体来看，日本表现优于韩国，但AI主题在第二季度也非常明确。

segments.en: Talk to us about the need to be maybe more selective this quarter and what is the trend underlying that you see.
segments.zh: 谈谈本季度是否需要更加精选标的，以及你看到的潜在趋势。

segments.en: Definitely, I think you're right. Being selective this quarter is going to be quite important because as we've been discussing or as we've seen, the past quarter has seen one of the strongest runs in a while within the tech space.
segments.zh: 确实，我认为你说得对。本季度精选标的非常重要，因为正如我们所见，过去一个季度科技板块出现了近期最强劲的上涨之一。

segments.en: And there's a lot to like about tech. It's got quite a deep supply chain and you can basically follow the bottlenecks within the supply chain to find alpha opportunities.
segments.zh: 科技板块有很多值得喜欢的地方。它有很深的供应链，你可以顺着供应链中的瓶颈找到超额收益机会。

segments.en: My concern is that these elevated levels and with the volatility we've seen in the market, you really have to be quite selective to be sure that you're picking stocks that haven't overshot on fundamentals.
segments.zh: 我担心的是，在目前的高位和市场波动下，你必须非常精选，确保你选择的标的没有在基本面上过度上涨。
